import hashlib,json,sys,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/targets/pecan-typed-tests-20261001/support')
assert root.is_dir() and not list(root.iterdir())
with tarfile.open(fileobj=sys.stdin.buffer,mode='r|gz') as bundle:
 for m in bundle:
  assert m.isfile() and Path(m.name).name==m.name
  bundle.extract(m,root,filter='data')
manifest=root/'support-manifest.json'
assert hashlib.sha256(manifest.read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='0f378b86d2feaa93413d1fe573eef524c110f1c019f2dace955c22d1a8f5dc39'
for name,expected in json.loads(manifest.read_text())['files_sha256'].items():
 assert hashlib.sha256((root/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
print(json.dumps({'support_staged':True,'cells':list((root.parent/'cells').iterdir())}))
